observed_fault.cause: A QueryCanceled in the read-only same-cycle lease helper escaped as CONSUME/UNAVAILABLE, blocked the cycle and lost JEV continuation priority.
observed_fault.causality_limit: Dashboard query timeouts were also observed; no causal attribution to dashboard load or individual trade losses was established.

implementation.conservative_result: Original DEFERRED / JEV_RESULT_PENDING; no further consume while lease validity is unknown.
implementation.scheduling: Existing token-guarded ACK persists the existing one-second continuation, with no same-run spin or new queue.
implementation.additional_guard: Recheck stop and recompute monotonic scheduler budget after the read completes.
implementation.release_isolation: Prepared from the actual Nov8 immutable runtime; unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes excluded. Full manifests: 1196 files each, exactly one modified, none deleted.
implementation.known_limit: Connection establishment/setup latency is not governed by the helper's 100 ms SQL timeout. Other latency causes and production efficacy remain unverified.

first_new_test_run.cause: Fixture advanced beyond signal expiry but expected IGNORED rather than the correct EXPIRED. Split into independent signal-expiry and JEV-deadline cases, asserting exact receipts; no production code changed for this correction.

qa.isolation: Serialized disposable Unix-socket PG/Redis; external Python network guard; fake venue/model; QA databases removed by verified cleanup.
qa.scope_limit: Selected relevant suites, not the entire repository; no real exchange order or model call was initiated by QA. Not proof of profitable trading.

release.next_required_condition: Fresh local and GET-only venue flat proof, followed by the existing stopped-executor second flat gate before switching release.

baseline_observation.note: Still the OLD deployed release; reuse of a diagnostic named postrelease does not mean this fix was deployed.
baseline_observation.completeness: Cycle window complete, candidate detail capped; not an exhaustive signal census.
baseline_observation.inference: Do not claim current trading is wholly healthy or the online latency defect is fixed.

research.conclusions: Same-bar deduplication does not establish a new wave after a previous trade. Investigate causal reset/confirmation prospectively. Winners are more extended on median, so JCT does not justify a generic extension veto or fixed cooldown.
